remarks: Set within one of the area's most coveted neighborhoods, this exceptional colonial residence embodies timeless elegance & gracious Southern charm. Beautifully maintained & thoughtfully designed, the home offers an inviting sense of warmth & refinement that is felt from the moment you arrive. Manicured grounds frame the property in privacy and tranquility, creating a serene backdrop for daily living. The pool, perfectly scaled & quietly elegant, enhances the setting-ideal for peaceful afternoons, relaxed gatherings, & unhurried summer evenings. Inside, generously proportioned rooms & a flowing layout create a home that lives as beautifully as it entertains. A private home office provides a quiet retreat for work or reflection, while a dedicated guest suite offers visitors comfort and privacy, allowing them to feel truly at home. The heart of the residence is the chef's kitchen, thoughtfully appointed with premium appliances & refined finishes, where everyday moments & special occasions unfold with ease. Throughout the home, classic craftsmanship & attention to detail create a sense of enduring quality & understated luxury. Outdoors, the bluestone patio offers a private & inviting extension of the living space-perfect for alfresco dining, evening conversation, or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings. Balancing tranquility with convenience, this distinguished property is more than a home-it is a lifestyle defined by grace, comfort, & timeless appeal! Welcome Home!
